senses.gloss:
Yuddha in the Rigveda^1 and later^2 denotes ‘battle.’ The
more usual word earlier^3 is Yudh.
1) x. 54, 2.
2) Taittirīya Brāhmaṇa, i. 5, 9, 1;
Aitareva Brāhmaṇa, iii. 39, 1. 2;
vi. 36, 2; Śatapatha Brāhmaṇa, xiii. 1,
5, 6; Kauṣītaki Upaniṣad, iii. 1, etc.
3) Rv. i. 53, 7; 59, 1; v. 25, 6; vi. 46,
11, etc.; Av. i. 24, 1; iv. 24, 7;
vi. 66, 1; 103, 3, etc.; Śatapatha
Brāhmaṇa, v. 2, 4, 16, etc.
